name: 50_SHOPPING_ZONE_SPEED_SIGN
notes: Department of State Growth (formerly DIER) standard drawing, black line-work sheet; every dimension from the sheet unless stated. Series/heights as the sheet's letter-type note; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing, so widths differ from the sheet's figures where its spacing is wider (the TAS sheets' 'medium'/'75%' spacing runs about 7% wider than AS 1744 normal spacing). Sheet G/10/474 'Shopping zone speed sign R4-1(50)SZ' (1999). 600 x 1100: an R4-1 600 x 800 speed sign (circle red retro-reflective, speed black non-reflective, background white retro-reflective Class 1) over a 300 zone carrying a bordered SHOPPING ZONE panel. The annulus and numerals are not dimensioned: AS 1743 R4-1 geometry used (annulus R297/R237 centred (300, 400), 240 D numerals top 280; the sheet's own ring measures about 535 dia). Lower panel from the chain 16/30/80/40/80/30/24 (top to bottom) and 24/29/494/29/24 across: panel 552 x 260 at (24, 816), black non-reflective border 5 wide (29 - 24; drawn as a thin double line, R20 outer measured), SHOPPING 80 Series D cap top 846, ZONE top 966 (40 between rows), ZONE 170/260/170. Corner radius R50 as R4-1 (measured about 50).
